name: Get Associated Meetings
description: Retrieves meetings associated with a specific object (contact, company, or deal) with optional time filtering. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/associations/association-details#get-%2Fcrm%2Fv4%2Fobjects%2F%7Bobjecttype%7D%2F%7Bobjectid%7D%2Fassociations%2F%7Btoobjecttype%7D)

configurable_props.name: objectType
configurable_props.label: From Object Type
configurable_props.description: The type of the object being associated

configurable_props.name: objectId
configurable_props.label: Object ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the object to get associated meetings for. For contacts, you can search by email.

configurable_props.name: timeframe
configurable_props.label: Time Frame
configurable_props.description: Filter meetings within a specific time frame

configurable_props.name: mostRecent
configurable_props.label: Most Recent Only
configurable_props.description: Only return the most recent meeting

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional Properties
configurable_props.description: Additional properties to retrieve for the meetings
